rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: form (b) — the Fix-guided Verification Filter is code that enforces the consequence of a step's outcome without a model choosing to honour it: it is 'applied only when the judge returns NO and provides a fix', then 'the final verdict is determined by four common outcomes' computed from executable tests — Case 1 (equivalent) and Case 3 (over-repair) 'flip the verdict to YES', overturning the LLM judge's NO on runtime evidence, with a bounded K=2 re-judge retry (Case 2). The LLM judge and GPT-4o test generation are model steps (precondition 2); the overriding harness is non-AI code at the top of the contributed system's flow.
